verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents bi-directional sync, a two-way connection with GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, so teammates can 'write in your preferred environment whether that's ReadMe or your local development setup'. A hybrid workflow keeps definitions in Git while the team writes docs in ReadMe, so web edits and git edits land in one source of truth. The in-app editor has a formatting toolbar, slash commands, multiplayer editing, branches and reviews, which gives non-git users a web authoring path. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the visual/WYSIWYG editor aimed at non-technical users, documentation of sync conflict handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync workflow.
